seeds.title: Goblin NPC table
seeds.evidence: CSV-style table headed NPC, HP, AC, Speed, Attack, Damage, Special Traits/Abilities, containing roles such as Goblin Trader, Engineer, Scout, Alchemist, Warden, Mechanic, Medic, Soldier, Spy, Scientist, Saboteur, Diplomat, Entrepreneur, Tactician, Miner, Outlaw, and Artificer.
auditNotes: Each row is a likely NPC archetype object.
Attacks and special traits may reference separate item, action, ability, proficiency, and crafting objects.
The table is embedded after Goblin setting prose and must not be treated as isolated from that context.

seeds.title: Dagger Combat Ability Tree
seeds.evidence: Tiered combat tree with unlock costs, tier prerequisites, passive/action/bonus-action/reaction nodes, saving throws, damage expressions, usage limits, and XP expansions.
auditNotes: The tree must be decomposed into progression family, tiers, nodes, prerequisites, effects, actions, usage rules, and upgrade nodes.
Narrative core mechanics are also reusable rules evidence.

seeds.title: Underwater cave and ocean encounter tables
seeds.evidence: Numbered hooks and encounters involving shipwrecks, merrow, magical trenches, sharks, sea serpents, currents, reefs, hidden treasure, enchanted coral, drowned cities, underwater temples, and monster islands.
auditNotes: Rows can imply multiple objects and relationships, not merely one adventure-hook record.
Named creatures, hazards, locations, artifacts, and environmental rules must be cross-checked separately.

seeds.title: Cyberpunk random encounters
seeds.evidence: Encounter rows reference drone patrols, fixers, cybernetics, corporate bounty hunters, acid rain, augmented performers, augmentation overload, hackers, gangs, and information brokers.
auditNotes: Technology, conditions, factions, NPC roles, weather hazards, and items must be extracted independently from the encounter rows.

seeds.title: Marketplace hooks and event table
seeds.evidence: Hooks include missing merchants, strange food buffs or curses, illegal magic-item vendors, hidden treasure knowledge, underground auctions, guards, theft accusations, pickpockets, and vendor fights.
auditNotes: Food effects may be item/effect/condition objects.
Auction, guard, vendor, and pickpocket content may imply reusable NPC, business, faction, and encounter objects.
